text: RESULTS: X-ray of the left hip reveals flattening and fragmentation of the left femoral head consistent with Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease. speaker: Doctor
text: The X-ray confirms flattening and fragmentation of your left femoral head, which explains why you feel pain in your knee even though the problem is actually in your hip. This condition is known as Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease, caused by a temporary loss of blood supply to the hip joint. DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease.
